title: Accident Detection
oneLiner: Dashcam accident-detection PoC on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano — with an honest on-device benchmark.
objective: Simulate an intelligent dashcam streaming endpoint that detects accidents in real time for timely acknowledgment.
achievements: Ran a MoViNet video-classification model fully on-device on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano, capturing from a live camera.
Designed a chunked streaming loop — 10-second chunks split into overlapping 2-second subclips — so an event on a boundary still lands inside one window, with capture never blocked by inference.
Added cloud alerting through Google Cloud on a positive detection.
Measured the real cost on the device: ~90 s to process each 10 s chunk, about 9× slower than real time — the number that showed the model had to change before live deployment.
